brief:
A Hamas leadership delegation met with representatives of Fatah's Democratic Reform faction in Beirut, according to Shehab Wire. The Fatah delegation was headed by Mahmoud Issa, secretary of the Lebanese arena and a brigadier general known as "Al-Lino."

The meeting took place amid broader efforts by Palestinian political groups to coordinate positions while operating from Lebanon. Hamas and Fatah have maintained separate organizational structures and rival power bases, though both claim to represent Palestinian interests. The encounter in Beirut reflects the complex dynamics of Palestinian politics, where rival movements sometimes engage in dialogue despite their fundamental divisions over strategy and governance.
